{{Quote|I found it years ago. When I was no older than you are now. I found it in the River of Light on my home planet.|Qui-Gon Jinn, handing Obi-Wan Kenobi a stone from the River of Light|<ref name="THP" />}}
A terrestrial '''planet''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. Though he left the [[Planet/Legends|world]] as an infant to [[Jedi training/Legends|become]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], he returned to visit it later in life. The planet had liquid surface [[Water/Legends|water]] and an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that was suitable for [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. A type of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Force-sensitive stone|stone]], [[River stone|one]] of which Jinn obtained from the [[River of Light]] and kept as a memento, was found on the world.

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was terrestrial<ref name="THP" /> and had a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]<ref name="Atmosphere" /> that could support [[Human/Legends|Human]] life. The world had liquid surface [[Water/Legends|water]], as exemplified by the [[River of Light]]. A [[Force-sensitive stone|type of stone]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was found in the River of Light. It was shiny black in [[Color/Legends|color]], with veins of deep red visible when viewed in bright light. The stone was warm to the touch and emitted [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] glow in the dark.<ref name="THP" />

==History==
[[File:Quigonheadshot.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Qui-Gon Jinn, a native of the planet]]
In [[92 BBY/Legends|92 BBY]],<ref name="JVS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> the Human [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was born on the planet. Not long after, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] discovered Jinn's Force-sensitivity, and he was taken to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to receive [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]].<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' {{C|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] entry}}</ref> Though most [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Great Peace of the Republic|era]] left their old lives completely behind once they were accepted into the Order,<ref name="JVS" /> Jinn kept some ties with his planet of birth. During a visit there<ref name="THP" /> around [[79 BBY]]<ref name="79 BBY">Based on Qui-Gon Jinn's birth year of 92 BBY given in [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']], it can be concluded that he was thirteen around 79 BBY.</ref> at age thirteen, he obtained a Force-sensitive [[River stone|stone]] from the River of Light.<ref name="THP" />

Keeping it for over thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] as a reminder of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Jinn, by then a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], eventually handed the stone to his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], when he turned thirteen<ref name="THP" /> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="44 BBY">According to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the events of ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Hidden Past]]'' take place in 44 BBY.</ref> Kenobi in turn gave the stone to his apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], on his thirteenth [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]]<ref name="TWOTA">''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]''</ref> in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].<ref name="29 BBY">According to the [[Holocron continuity database]] administrator [[Leland Chee]] ({{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}), Anakin Skywalker's birth year is [[42 BBY/Legends|41.9 BBY]]; therefore, his thirteenth birthday can be placed at 28.9 BBY.</ref> Knowledge of the existence of Force-sensitive river stones survived into the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[New Jedi Order]];<ref name="Droids">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/81/indexp7.html|text=Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena|int=Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena (article)}}</ref> following the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|end]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tam Azur-Jamin]] mentioned them in his essay ''[[Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena]]'', which discussed the emergence of the Force in inanimate objects and technological devices.<ref name="Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
Qui-Gon Jinn's homeworld was first mentioned in [[Jedi Apprentice: The Hidden Past|''The Hidden Past'']], the third installment in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] series that was written by [[Jude Watson]] and published in [[1999]].<ref name="THP" /> The planet has not been officially named; both ''The New Essential Guide to Characters''<ref name="NEGTC" /> and the [[2011]] book ''[[Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi]]''<ref name="MOTJ">''[[Star Wars: Mysteries of the Jedi]]''</ref> list Jinn's homeworld as "unknown," as did [[StarWars.com]]'s original [[Databank (original)|Databank]] encyclopedia.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|quigonjinn|Jinn, Qui-Gon}}</ref>

The [[2005]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article [[Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena (article)|''Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena'']], written by [[Abel G. Peña]], mentions the Force being found in "lifeless rocks like river stones."<ref name="Droids" /> In the article endnotes published on his StarWars.com blog, Peña specified that this was meant as a reference to the stones found on Qui-Gon Jinn's homeworld.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|abelgpena|47|Endnotes for ''Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena, Part I''}}</ref>
